update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.2 - Reliability, shop/scroll hardening, and a career-outcome log line
- New: a [CAREER_END] line written at the end of every career, recording the result, scenario, the turn it ended on, fans, final stats and skill points -- so a run's outcome is legible at a glance and easy to share in a bug report. The game shows the same screen for a clean finish and an early force-end, so the turn it ended on is the tell. - New: an option to skip double-circle (◎) skill upgrades and spread points across more single-circle skills instead (off by default). - Fixed: overnight runs that cross midnight no longer stall on the real-world date-rollover popup. - Fixed: the shop is confirmed open before buying, a scrollbar edge case no longer truncates long lists, and a dialog the recovery net can't clear now ends the run cleanly instead of spinning until the watchdog. - Fixed: the Remote Log Viewer's Compact toggle now re-renders the lines already on screen. - Validated with a 3-career unattended Trackblazer queue that completed end to end.
